en.title: Best Heated Jackets 2026
en.description: Ororo, Milwaukee, DEWALT, TIDEWE, Venustas, Gobi Heat, Bosch and Antarctica Gear ranked by real high-setting runtime against the low-setting marketing claim, disclosed battery watt-hours, safety certification, heating zone coverage, and whether the shell is washer safe once the battery is out.

zh-tw.title: 最佳電熱外套 2026
zh-tw.description: Ororo、Milwaukee、DEWALT、TIDEWE、Venustas、Gobi Heat、Bosch 與 Antarctica Gear 依高溫檔實際續航對照低溫檔行銷數字、電池瓦時是否公開、電池安全認證、發熱區覆蓋與拆電池後可否機洗排序。

en.description: Ororo's Mini 5K battery is spec'd at 7.4V, 4800mAh, 35.4Wh right on the product page, and it drives four zones (collar, mid-back, both hand pockets) for 10 hours on low, 6 on medium, and 3 on high, all UL, cUL, CE, FCC and RoHS certified.

zh-tw.description: Ororo 官網把電池規格講得很清楚,Mini 5K 電池 7.4V、4800mAh、35.4Wh 這三個數字直接寫在商品頁上,不用自己換算。四個發熱區覆蓋領口、後腰跟兩邊口袋,低溫檔可以撐 10 小時,高溫檔 3 小時,電池還通過 UL、cUL、CE、FCC、RoHS 五張認證,算是我查到認證最齊全的一款。

en.description: Pro Tool Reviews independently timed the AXIS at 2 hours 50 minutes with every zone on high, close to Milwaukee's claimed 3 hours, and the jacket is fully washer and dryer safe once the M12 battery is unplugged.

zh-tw.description: 這款我最喜歡的地方是有第三方實測背書,Pro Tool Reviews 拿它全部發熱區開到最高溫,實測撐了 2 小時 50 分,跟 Milwaukee 官方寫的 3 小時差距不大,算是講真話的廠商。外套本身洗衣機烘衣機都能丟,拔掉 M12 電池就好,比一堆只能手洗的競品方便太多。

en.description: The women's cut runs the same Mini 5K 35.4Wh battery as Ororo's men's jacket, with an optional 7000mAh Pro battery stretching low-setting runtime to 13.5 hours, and the page states the jacket is machine washable.

zh-tw.description: 女款用的是跟男款一樣的 Mini 5K 電池,35.4Wh 這個數字沒有變,還可以加價升級到 7000mAh 的 Pro 電池,低溫檔續航直接拉到 13.5 小時。官網寫機洗就可以,不用另外送洗,算是同一個電池平台裡我覺得比較划算的升級路線。

en.description: The kit ships with an M12 RedLithium CP3.0 battery, about 36Wh by voltage times capacity, rated 12 hours on low and 3 on high across chest, back and pocket zones, and Milwaukee lists the whole jacket as washer and dryer safe.

zh-tw.description: TOUGHSHELL 這款隨附的是 M12 RedLithium CP3.0 電池,用電壓乘容量自己換算大概 36Wh,官方沒有直接寫瓦時但至少型號查得到。官方標示低溫檔 12 小時、高溫檔 3 小時,發熱區在胸口、後背跟口袋,整件外套官方寫洗衣機烘衣機都能用,比很多同類產品省事。

en.description: At $129.99 this is the cheapest UL, FCC, RoHS and CE certified battery in the lineup (10,000mAh, 5V, about 50Wh by the math), rated for 50-plus machine washes once the battery pack is out, though TideWe's listing never states how many heating zones the jacket has.

zh-tw.description: TIDEWE 賣 129.99 美元,是這張榜單裡最便宜還通過 UL、FCC、RoHS、CE 四張認證的電池,10,000mAh、5V,換算下來大概 50Wh。拔掉電池可以承受 50 次以上機洗,耐用度寫得很明確。可惜商品頁完全沒提到到底有幾個發熱區,這點交代得不清不楚。

en.description: Venustas sells three battery tiers for the same $149.99 jacket, from the standard 5000mAh/7.4V/37Wh pack up to a Max 10000mAh/7.4V/74Wh pack rated for 20 hours on low, though the base jacket heats only two zones, chest and pocket.

zh-tw.description: Venustas 同一件 149.99 美元的外套可以搭三種電池,從標準版 5000mAh、7.4V、37Wh,一路升到 Max 版 10000mAh、7.4V、74Wh,低溫檔號稱能撐 20 小時。不過基本款外套只有胸口跟口袋兩個發熱區,覆蓋範圍是這幾款裡面最小的。

en.description: Sahara II charges via USB-C PD across a wide 5V-20V range, and Gobi Heat's own numbers show the smallest gap between claim and reality in this lineup, 10 hours low, 8 medium, 5 high, though the battery is spec'd only in mAh, never watt-hours.

zh-tw.description: Sahara II 用 USB-C PD 快充,電壓範圍 5V 到 20V 都吃,官方自己寫的續航是低溫 10 小時、中溫 8 小時、高溫 5 小時,這是我查到高低溫落差最小的一款,代表高溫檔不會縮水太誇張。缺點是電池規格只寫 mAh,完全沒有標瓦時,沒辦法跟別家直接比大小。

en.description: This is the biggest battery on paper, a 16,000mAh 12V power bank working out to roughly 192Wh, more than five times Ororo's pack, but it's a detachable USB power bank rather than a purpose-built garment battery, and Antarctica Gear lists only CE and FCC, no UL listing at all.

zh-tw.description: 帳面上電池最大的就是這款,16,000mAh、12V 的行動電源規格,換算下來大概 192Wh,是 Ororo 電池的五倍以上。不過講清楚一點,它其實是外接式行動電源,不是專門設計給衣服用的電池模組,而且認證只寫 CE 跟 FCC,完全沒有 UL 這張美規安全認證,買的時候要有這個底。

competitors.name: DCHJ072D1 Lightweight Soft-Shell Heated Jacket Kit

en.description: DEWALT's own pages disagree with each other: the product overview claims up to 9 hours on low with the 20V MAX 2.0Ah battery, a features list on the same page says 7 hours, and a third listing for the same battery class cites 5.5 hours, with no watt-hour figure published anywhere.

zh-tw.description: DEWALT 這款我查的時候發現自己官網打架,同一頁的產品總覽寫低溫檔用 20V MAX 2.0Ah 電池能撐 9 小時,功能列表卻寫 7 小時,另一個地方又寫換成 1.5Ah 小電池是 5.5 小時,三個數字對不起來,而且瓦時完全沒公開,要買的人自己去猜。

en.description: Bosch's own spec sheet lists three heat settings and a 12V 2.0Ah battery but never states a single runtime number for any setting, and care instructions say hand washable only, no washer or dryer claim like its Milwaukee and DEWALT rivals.

zh-tw.description: Bosch 這款規格表寫了三段溫控跟 12V 2.0Ah 電池,但低中高三個檔位居然一個續航數字都沒公布,是我查的十款裡唯一完全不寫續航時間的。清洗說明也只寫手洗,沒有像 Milwaukee 跟 DEWALT 那樣敢講洗衣機烘衣機都能用。

en.commentary:
I built this ranking around one gap I kept hitting while researching heated jackets: the marketing headline runtime is always the low setting, and the number that actually matters, how long the jacket stays warm when you need real heat, sits three to five times shorter and often isn't published as cleanly.

Ororo's Men's Classic Heated Jacket 2.0 wins because it is the one product on this list that discloses everything at once: the Mini 5K battery is spec'd at 7.4V, 4800mAh, 35.4Wh right on the page, it carries five safety certifications (UL, cUL, CE, FCC, RoHS), and it still ships at $139.99, the second-cheapest jacket here. Its women's counterpart runs the same battery platform and lands third.

The Milwaukee M12 AXIS earns second place on the strength of independent verification. Pro Tool Reviews clocked it at 2 hours 50 minutes with every zone on high, within striking distance of Milwaukee's claimed 3 hours, a rare case in this category of a third party actually confirming a manufacturer's claimed number.

The two jackets I ranked lowest, DEWALT's DCHJ072D1 and Bosch's GHJ12V-20MN12, share the same problem from different angles. DEWALT's own web pages state three different low-setting runtimes for the same battery class, 5.5, 7 and 9 hours, depending on which page you land on. Bosch's official spec sheet lists three heat settings and never states a runtime number for any of them, the only jacket here with that gap.

If you care about the actual number on the box, buy from a brand that publishes watt-hours, not just milliamp-hours or a marketing phrase like 'up to.' That single disclosure habit tracks almost perfectly with how the rest of my scoring landed.

highlights.title: Ororo wins by disclosing what everyone else hides
highlights.body: Ororo prints the Mini 5K battery's full spec, 7.4V, 4800mAh, 35.4Wh, directly on the product page, backs it with five certifications (UL, cUL, CE, FCC, RoHS), and still charges $139.99. No other jacket in this ranking states its watt-hours and certification count in one place, and that combination is why both the men's and women's Ororo jackets land in my top three.

highlights.title: The AXIS is the one high-setting claim I'd trust without checking
highlights.body: Milwaukee says the M12 AXIS runs 3 hours on high with every zone active. Pro Tool Reviews independently tested it and measured 2 hours 50 minutes under the same conditions, a 6% gap that is well within normal battery variance. Combined with a washer-and-dryer-safe shell, this is the jacket I'd recommend to someone who wants the number on the box to actually mean something.

highlights.title: DEWALT's own website contradicts itself on runtime
highlights.body: The DCHJ072D1 product page states up to 9 hours on low with the 20V MAX 2.0Ah battery in its overview section, lists 7 hours in its features bullet list on the same page, and a separate DEWALT listing for the same battery class cites 5.5 hours. None of the three pages publish a watt-hour figure, so a buyer has no way to tell which number, if any, applies to the exact kit they're purchasing.

highlights.title: Bosch is the only jacket here that never states a runtime
highlights.body: The GHJ12V-20MN12's official spec sheet lists a 12V 2.0Ah battery and three heat settings, but it does not print a single hour figure for low, medium, or high. Every other jacket in this ranking, even the ones with inconsistent numbers, at least attempts a claim. Bosch's care instructions also stop at 'hand washable,' the only jacket here without a washer-safe claim.

highlights.title: Antarctica Gear's 192Wh battery is huge, but read the fine print
highlights.body: At 16,000mAh and 12V, Antarctica Gear's power bank works out to roughly 192Wh, more than five times Ororo's 35.4Wh pack, for the lowest price in this ranking at $119. But it's a detachable USB power bank, not a garment-integrated battery, and the brand lists only CE and FCC certification, no UL listing. Big numbers on a spec sheet aren't the same as the safety paperwork the tool brands carry.

zh-tw.commentary:
做這份排行榜的時候我發現一個規律,幾乎每家的續航數字都是低溫檔的,真正要保暖的高溫檔實際只剩三分之一到五分之一,而且很多家連公開的意願都沒有。

Ororo 男款 Classic Heated Jacket 2.0 排第一,理由很簡單,它是唯一一款把資訊全部攤開來的產品。Mini 5K 電池 7.4V、4800mAh、35.4Wh 三個數字直接寫在商品頁,電池還一次拿到 UL、cUL、CE、FCC、RoHS 五張認證,價格 139.99 美元還是這十款裡第二便宜的。女款用同一個電池平台,排第三。

第二名是 Milwaukee M12 AXIS,靠的是有第三方實測撐腰。Pro Tool Reviews 拿它全部發熱區開到最高溫實測,撐了 2 小時 50 分,跟官方宣稱的 3 小時差距不大。這個品類裡很少看到廠商講的數字被第三方驗證得這麼接近,算是難得的誠實案例。

排最後兩名的 DEWALT DCHJ072D1 跟 Bosch GHJ12V-20MN12,問題角度不一樣但本質一樣。DEWALT 自己的官網對同一顆電池寫了三個不一樣的低溫續航,5.5 小時、7 小時、9 小時,看你點進哪一頁。Bosch 的官方規格表寫了三段溫控,卻一個續航數字都沒公布,是這十款裡唯一完全不寫續航的。

如果你在意的是規格上那個數字到底準不準,建議挑會公開瓦時的品牌,不要只看 mAh 或「最長」這種模糊字眼。這個公開習慣幾乎直接決定了我這次的排名結果。

highlights.title: Ororo 贏在別人不敢寫的資訊它全部寫出來
highlights.body: Ororo 把 Mini 5K 電池的完整規格,7.4V、4800mAh、35.4Wh,直接印在商品頁上,還拿到 UL、cUL、CE、FCC、RoHS 五張認證,價格卻只要 139.99 美元。這份榜單裡沒有第二款同時公開瓦時跟認證張數的產品,男款女款能一起擠進前三名,靠的就是這個組合。

highlights.title: AXIS 是我唯一敢直接相信官方續航數字的一款
highlights.body: Milwaukee 說 M12 AXIS 全部發熱區開高溫可以撐 3 小時,Pro Tool Reviews 自己實測同樣條件下撐了 2 小時 50 分,落差只有 6%,算是電池正常的誤差範圍。加上外套整件洗衣機烘衣機都能丟,這是我會推薦給想要規格表上的數字是真的這種人的一款。

highlights.title: DEWALT 自己的官網三個頁面寫三個續航數字
highlights.body: DCHJ072D1 商品頁的總覽區寫 20V MAX 2.0Ah 電池低溫檔可以撐 9 小時,同一頁的功能列表卻寫 7 小時,另一個賣同顆電池的頁面又寫 5.5 小時。三個頁面都沒有公布瓦時,買的人根本沒辦法確認自己買到的那組電池對應哪一個數字。

highlights.title: Bosch 是十款裡唯一一款完全不寫續航時間的
highlights.body: GHJ12V-20MN12 官方規格表寫了 12V 2.0Ah 電池跟三段溫控,但低、中、高三個檔位一個小時數都沒公布。這份榜單裡其他款式即使數字前後不一致,至少都願意寫一個數字出來,Bosch 連寫都沒寫。清洗說明也只停在可手洗,是這裡唯一沒有敢講洗衣機安全的一款。

highlights.title: Antarctica Gear 的 192Wh 電池很唬人,但要看清楚它是什麼
highlights.body: 16,000mAh、12V 換算下來大概 192Wh,是 Ororo 電池 35.4Wh 的五倍以上,價格卻是這份榜單裡最低的 119 美元。不過講清楚一點,它其實是外接式行動電源,設計成夾在口袋裡外接供電,而且認證只有 CE 跟 FCC,沒有 UL 這張美規安全認證。規格表上的大數字很吸睛,真正該優先看的是安全認證文件。

references.title: Top Premium Heated Gear Brands Worth Investing In for Winter 2026

en.commentary:
Ororo's Men's Classic Heated Jacket 2.0 keeps the top spot at 9.2, and this month's wider gear coverage backs up the call from an independent angle, Outdoor Life's 2026 roundup lands on the same jacket for the same reasons I do, the highest safety certification score in this field, 9.8, paired with a battery-removed washability score of 9.2 that lets you actually run the shell through a washing machine without frying the electronics.

Milwaukee's M12 Heated AXIS Jacket holds second at 8.8 with the best high-heat runtime and care-ease scores on this entire chart, 9.5 and a perfect 10.0, a battery pack you fully disconnect before laundering, which matters more than most buyers realize until they ruin a $200 jacket in the first wash cycle. Ororo's Women's Classic Heated Jacket 2.0 sits third at 8.7 with the same safety-first engineering as the men's version.

I'm tracking a wave of premium heated gear brands, Arcfomor, Snow Deer, Venture Heat, and Seirus among them, getting fresh attention as winter buying season ramps up, but none of them have published the kind of independent battery watt-hour disclosure or safety certification data that would let me score them fairly against what's already ranked here. Once a brand actually states its certification standard alongside a real runtime claim, I'll consider adding it.

Tidewe's Men's Heated Jacket continues to hold fifth as the value option, a 7.8 safety certification score that's solid without matching the top four. Nothing moved a score far enough this week to reshuffle, so the ranking holds as winter shopping season begins in earnest.

highlights.title: Ororo Wins Independently Too
highlights.body: Outdoor Life's 2026 roundup lands on the same pick, citing the same 9.8 safety certification score.

highlights.title: Milwaukee AXIS Wins on Washability
highlights.body: A perfect 10.0 care-ease score, the battery fully disconnects before laundering, protecting the jacket from a ruined first wash.

highlights.title: New Premium Brands Still Unproven on Safety Data
highlights.body: Arcfomor, Snow Deer, and Venture Heat are getting winter buzz but have yet to publish certification data that would let them score fairly.

highlights.title: Tidewe Remains the Value Pick
highlights.body: A 7.8 safety certification score at a lower price point than the top four.

zh-tw.commentary:
Ororo 男款經典二代還是排第一，九點二分。這個月比較廣的裝備報導從另一個角度證實了這個判斷，Outdoor Life 二〇二六年度榜單選的也是同一款，理由跟我一樣，安全認證分數九點八全場最高，加上電池拆卸後可水洗分數九點二，代表真的可以把外殼丟進洗衣機，不會燒壞電路。

Milwaukee M12 Heated AXIS Jacket 守住第二，八點八分，高溫續航跟保養便利分數是全場最高，九點五跟滿分十分，電池要完全拆下來才能下水洗，這一點比大多數買家想像的更重要，很多人第一次洗就毀了一件兩百美元的外套。Ororo 女款經典二代排第三，八點七分，安全性工程跟男款一致。

我這幾週也在關注一批新的高階發熱衣品牌，Arcfomor、Snow Deer、Venture Heat、Seirus 都在冬季採購季拿到不少關注。可惜這些品牌都還沒公布過獨立驗證的電池瓦時數據或安全認證標準，光憑續航時數的宣傳字眼，我沒辦法把它們放進這張表跟現有名次公平比較。等到有品牌真的講清楚自己的認證規格，我才會考慮加進來。

Tidewe 男款發熱外套繼續守住第五名的價值選擇，安全認證分數七點八，紮實但沒有前四名那麼強。這禮拜沒有分數動得夠大，排名照舊，冬季採購季才剛要開始。

highlights.title: Ororo 獨立評測也拿下第一
highlights.body: Outdoor Life 二〇二六年度榜單選的也是同一款，引用的一樣是九點八分的安全認證分數。

highlights.title: Milwaukee AXIS 贏在可水洗
highlights.body: 保養便利分數滿分十分，電池要完全拆下來才能下水洗，避免第一次洗就毀了外套。

highlights.title: 新興高階品牌安全數據還沒公開
highlights.body: Arcfomor、Snow Deer、Venture Heat 冬季話題度高，但都還沒公布過能讓我公平評分的認證數據。

highlights.title: Tidewe 依然是價值選擇
highlights.body: 安全認證分數七點八，價格比前四名親民不少。

en.commentary:
Ororo's Men's Classic Heated Jacket 2.0 keeps the top spot, and the number that keeps it there is a documented one: a 7.4V, 4800mAh, 35.4Wh battery, spec'd directly on the product page, running four zones for 10 hours on low. That's a rare case in this category where the manufacturer publishes the actual watt-hour math instead of just a mAh number that requires a calculator to compare against anything else.

I want to address the Milwaukee gap directly, because I know some coverage this month called the newer M12 Toughshell Milwaukee's own top pick over the AXIS. I'm keeping AXIS at second anyway, because Pro Tool Reviews actually put a stopwatch on it and measured 2 hours 50 minutes of real-world runtime with every zone on high, within minutes of Milwaukee's claimed 3 hours. Toughshell's 12-hour low and 3-hour high figures are still just Milwaukee's own published claims, not yet checked by the same stopwatch method, and until someone runs that test on it, I trust the verified number over the newer model's spec sheet.

Ororo's women's cut holds third on the same battery platform, with an optional 7000mAh Pro pack stretching low-setting runtime to 13.5 hours for anyone who wants more range than the standard pack offers. TideWe stays fifth as the cheapest certified battery in the lineup at $129.99, UL, FCC, RoHS and CE certified, rated for 50-plus machine washes.

Nothing else moved this week, so the rest of the order carries forward unchanged.

highlights.title: Ororo Publishes Real Watt-Hour Math, Not Just mAh
highlights.body: A 7.4V, 4800mAh, 35.4Wh battery spec'd directly on the product page lets buyers make an actual apples-to-apples comparison, a transparency level most competitors in this category skip.

highlights.title: AXIS Beats Toughshell on Independently Verified Runtime
highlights.body: Pro Tool Reviews clocked 2 hours 50 minutes on full heat, within minutes of Milwaukee's claim, while Toughshell's longer runtime figures remain unverified by the same test method.

highlights.title: Ororo Women's Pro Battery Adds Real Range at 13.5 Hours
highlights.body: The optional 7000mAh Pro pack stretches low-setting runtime well past the standard battery, giving buyers a real upgrade path for longer days outdoors.

highlights.title: TideWe Is the Cheapest Certified Battery in the Lineup
highlights.body: $129.99 for a UL, FCC, RoHS and CE certified battery rated for 50-plus machine washes is the strongest certified-safety value anywhere in this ranking.

zh-tw.commentary:
Ororo的男款經典發熱外套2.0繼續守住第一，官網直接標示7.4V、4800mAh、35.4Wh的電池規格，驅動四個發熱區，低檔能撐10小時，這種公布真實瓦時數的做法在這個類別裡並不常見。

我想回應Milwaukee這邊的疑問，這個月有評測把新款M12 Toughshell列為Milwaukee自家首選，但我還是把AXIS留在第二，因為Pro Tool Reviews實測全開發熱區跑出2小時50分鐘，跟官方宣稱的3小時幾乎吻合，Toughshell的數字目前還沒經過同樣方式驗證。

references.title: The Best Heated Gear of 2026, Tested for Warmth and Battery Life

en.commentary:
Ororo's Men's Classic Heated Jacket 2.0 stays first, and I want to use this week to explain how I read the Milwaukee M12 Heated AXIS in second. Bob Vila's 2026 heated gear test names Milwaukee's ToughShell model as a top pick with the Axis a close second, and it credits the HEXON heat technology with fast heat-up and broad coverage. That matches what my table shows: the AXIS scores 9.5 for high heat and a perfect 10.0 for care ease.

So why does the Ororo lead? Its 9.8 safety certification score and 9.5 battery score. A jacket that sits against your body for a full commute or a long shift should carry documented safety credentials, and the battery gives it a real runtime advantage over the AXIS at 8.0.

The Women's Classic Heated Jacket 2.0 takes third with a 9.3 battery score and 8.5 high heat, a solid pick for anyone who wants Ororo's reliable design in a women's cut.

How to choose: if you already own Milwaukee M12 batteries, the AXIS is a natural fit and it warms up quickly. If you are starting from scratch, the Ororo's included battery and certification make it the easier first purchase.

For timing, the cold season is arriving, and Prime Big Deal Days on October 6 and 7 is confirmed by Amazon, so keep an eye on listings then.
